messages:
Priya Nair: Quick update on the review cycle timeline shift 2: we moved calibration week by 3 business days to accommodate the holiday in EU. Please read and action.

Carlos Mendes: Got it. Does this change the hard deadline for manager handbacks?

Priya Nair: Yes 2: manager handback deadline shifts from May 12 -> May 15. Individual contributor submission window still closes May 10. Managers must complete handbacks within 48h of receipt.

Zoe Lin: If a manager cant meet 48h due to travel/LOA, whats the escalation path?

Priya Nair: Two options: 1) delegate to a backup reviewer (preferred) or 2) request a formal extension via this quick form: https://forms.redwood.com/review-extensions. Extensions are granted only for documented LOA or emergency.

Carlos Mendes: How do we declare a backup reviewer? Is there a template?

Priya Nair: Add a short CSV to the form or DM me. CSV template:```csv
manager_email,backup_reviewer_email,notes
carlos@redwood.ai,zoe.lin@redwood.ai,covering conference week
```

People Ops Bot: notice: We will enforce a reviewer conflict check when backups are assigned (no direct-report backups). See docs: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/conflicts

Zoe Lin: For calibration, are we still doing anonymized batches? I want to prep my examples.

Priya Nair: Yes, calibration remains anonymized and aggregated into 3 buckets by level. Please submit your calibration examples by May 12 (new date). Well send a template and rubric.

Carlos Mendes: Can we carve out a "manager-only" 30-min prep session before calibration? Some managers asked for a quick sync.

Priya Nair: Added a 30-min optional manager prep slot on May 14. Sign up link: https://calendly.com/people-ops/manager-prep. Slots are first-come.

People Ops Bot: reminder: calibration quorum requires >=60% of managers in each org to attend. If quorum not met, we'll run a second session the following day.

Zoe Lin: Also, is there an easy way to see which review forms are still missing attachments? Our team has a few people who forgot to attach self-assessments.

Priya Nair: Well post a per-team missing-attachments CSV by EOD today to the manager dashboard and email managers the list. Quick sample:```csv
employee_email,missing_items
andy@redwood.ai,self-assessment
meera@redwood.ai,goals attachment
```

Carlos Mendes: For calibration voting, are we using the new anonymized ballot flow? I remember some teams testing it.

Priya Nair: Yes - calibrated votes will go through the anonymized ballot UI. Well share a short how-to gif and a one-pager in the docs.

Manager Ops Bot: automated-note: Rolling exports will be available to managers with >3 reports. Exports update hourly during the last 72h before calibration.

Priya Nair: Final note 2: if you anticipate >10% of your org missing forms by May 10, please flag me directly so we can extend a targeted reminder campaign. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :sparkles:
